variety_description: An early maturity, semi-dwarf, long-slender grain variety grown extensively in northern & eastern India mainly under irrigated and  upland areas. Developed by IIRR and IRRI and released in 2014. Sturdy short stem, erect flag leaf, good grain quality. Recommended for planting in aerobic and drought prone shallow low lands in kharif & rabi seasons.
